rounds: Good design is invisible: if you notice it, something has gone wrong.
Cars should have real buttons, not just one big touchscreen.
Shops should always have to accept cash.
Uni lectures should always be recorded, so anyone can watch them later.
Dark mode should be the default setting on every app.
Companies only care about accessibility when the law forces them.
Train tickets should always be sold at a counter, not only in an app.
A beautiful product that some people can't use can still be good design.
